description: Mechanical Vibration is a common phenomenon occurring in a mechanical system. The experimental studies are required to understand the fundamental and advance concepts of mechanical vibrations. Course learning objectives: to develop the understanding of basic concepts of Mechanical Vibrations with the help of experiments; to find natural frequency of free and forced vibrations of undamped and damped mechanical systems for understanding the theoretical concepts of Mechanical Vibrations; to find viscous damping from the response curve of damped free vibrations of a Mechanical System; to develop the understanding of Torsional Vibrations; to verify some of the methods of finding natural frequency of Mechanical Systems.
experiments: To study undamped free vibrations of equivalent spring mass system & determine the natural frequency of vibrations.
To study the free vibrations of the system for different damper setting. Draw the decay curve and determine the log decrement and damping factor. Determine the natural frequency.
To study the torsional vibrations of a single rotor shaft system and to determine the natural frequency.
To perform the experimental modal analysis using the Modal analysis apparatus.
To determine the two frequencies of the torsional spring type double pendulum and compare them with theoretical values.
To determine the radius of gyration of given bar by using Bifilar suspension.
To study the forced vibrations of the system with damping. Plot magnification factor vs. frequency and phase angle vs. frequency curves. Also, determine the damping factor.
To practice the measurement of the vibrations of any mechanical component using the vibration analysis equipment i.e. accelerometers, Data acquisition system.
outcomes: Perform Vibrations analysis of a Mechanical System or component.
Determine the system properties of a component of machine or Machine itself by performing free vibrations tests.
Determine the viscous damping present in a Mechanical system.

Understand theoretical concepts of Mechanical Vibrations. Analyse the response of the Vibrations Test to understand the theoretical results obtained from Mathematical Modelling of the Mechanical System under periodic input.
